explanation: Controller-driven body 0 converges exactly onto its final waypoint (17.1,7.9) by step 2909 with ~1e-14 velocity. On the next step its position/velocity become non-finite. The pattern indicates the waypoint-seeking law normalizes by distance-to-target (or commanded-direction) without a zero-distance guard, so exact arrival yields 0/0 = NaN which propagates into force, velocity and position.
